tei:titleStmt.tei:title: gnyis pa ming byang gi cho ga ni/shog bu dang gro ga la sogs pa la/tshe 'das kyi gzugs kyi snying gar sa bon nṛ'i 'og tu ming byang dang bcas pa bri ba'am/bas
gnyis pa ming byang gi cho ga ni/shog bu dang gro ga la sogs pa la/tshe 'das kyi gzugs kyi snying gar sa bon nṛ'i 'og tu ming byang dang bcas pa bri ba'am/bas

tei:div.tei:p: gnyis pa ming byang gi cho ga ni/ shog bu dang gro ga la sogs pa la/ tshe 'das kyi gzugs kyi snying gar sa bon nṛ'i 'og tu ming byang dang bcas pa bri ba'am/ bsdu na sa bon tsam bris kyang rung ste// de la dmigs nas ming byang bran la/ oṃ badz+ra a mri tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyang*/ skad cig nṛ yig yongs gyur las// mdun du tshe las 'das pa ni// gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba// yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// bden pa chen pos tshe 'das kyi// rnam shes rigs drug gar gnas kyang*// skad cig rten 'dir mchis gyur cig /sbyang chas rnams bsang sbyang*/ oṃ a kā ro sogs/ sarba bighān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs nas ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ de swā hā/ yang sngags de dang*/ oṃ sum+bha ni sogs nas ra dzā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sbrel ba tshar gsum/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthus tshe las 'das pa'i mtho ris dang thar pa sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su song zhig /gal te 'gro bar mi byed na ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar bas bsregs cing 'joms par gdon mi za'o// hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub// khyod rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal ba brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// sum+bha ni sogs brjod cing yungs kar gyis brab cing bgegs bskrad/

tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib kaṃ nag po'i rnam par sna bug nas thon/ mdun gyi til la thim par gyur// oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smin ku ru hūm̐ swā hā/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mer bsregs/ g.yon du rgya mtsho chen por dor bas byang zhing dag par gyur// na mo bha ga wa te/ a k+ṣo bh+ya ya sogs rtsa sngags lan bdun brjod/ gzungs sngags rnams dang*/ yig brgya bcas brjod/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ rten khrus ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a bhi ṣe sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// dmigs yul lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung gsung la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// dmigs yul lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā la wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣe sogs nas hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra wa s+t+ra āḥ srab 'jam yangs pa lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// dmigs yul rdo rje'i sku thob shog

/oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐/ lhag bsam dag pa'i na bza' 'di 'bul bas// lus la ngur smrig gos gyon sems la ni// ngo tsha khrel yod bzod pa'i gos gyon nas// rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum la mched par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra sogs/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐/ khrus chu las bum nang blug ste/ des gzugs brnyan bkru zhing*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o// de bzhin du/ 'di ni tshul khrims= tshul 'chal= tshul khrims= 'di ni bzod pa'i= khong khro'i= 'di ni brtson 'grus= le lo'i= 'di ni bsam gtan= rnam g.yeng = 'di ni shes rab= shes 'chal= sogs rtsa sngags mthar satwā nañtsa sarba pā paṃ k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ dmigs yul gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gal la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri chu drug gi khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad cing*// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// gong ltar sngags bcas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*// rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang*// dgra bcom rnams kyi mthu dag dang*// gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*// shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang*// mauṅgal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang*// ma 'gag pa yi mig dang ni// 'od srung sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// koṇ+ḍi ṇ+ya'i sngar thob dang*// kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang*// tshangs pa yi ni byams pa dang*// brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang*// dbang phyug chen po'i stobs dang ldan// ded dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang*// 'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*// de dag rnams kyi mthu dag gzis// che ge'i dug ni dug med shog

/rtsa sngags dang bcas/ 'don chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// de bzhin du/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs/ skyob pa'i dam chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun= dug bcom mo/ bar dang*/ rtsa sngags bcas/ dmigs yul gyi dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sa ni dug gi pha yin te// sa ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dmigs yul dug ni dug med shog /de bzhin/ chu ni= me ni= rlung ni= dug med shog /rtsa sngags dang dmigs yul gyi 'byung ba dang 'byung ba las gyur pa'i dug thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la bde legs= ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang zhig bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed = skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin tu rtag skyong des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur// gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs= gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs= dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing*// don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed = gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas par rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed = byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur ba des// khyed la bde legs=

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsung zhing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed = yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed = sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs shog /khyed la sdig par ma gyur cig /skabs 'dir byang phyag gang 'os dang*/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba'i skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la// tshe 'das skyabs su mchi lags so// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi// tshe 'das 'jigs pas rnam skrag nas// kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la'ang bdag nyid kyis// tshe 'das lus 'di 'bul bar bgyi// thugs rjes spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan 'di la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje'i bdag nyid thams cad la// skyabs tshol snying nas 'o 'dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa'i// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs las myur du bskyab tu gsol// de nas dbang bskur ba la gzhung ltar/

ji ltar bltams pa= sa gzhi spos chus= dga' chen khyod bdag sogs nas/ bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod kyi bar brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ sa gzhi spos chus sogs/ deng nas brtsam ste sogs byas la/ de ltar dbang bskur ba thob nas dmigs yul de nyid lha rnams dang skal pa mnyam par gyur// de nas 'dod yon bsngo ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ a kā ro sogs/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// dmigs yul rten gyi lha la gzugs 'bul na/ bde chen ye shes mchog gi spyod gyur cig /oṃ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan ci mchis pa// dmigs yul rten gyi lha la sgra 'bul na// bde chen ye shes= oṃ shab+da kā ma= phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dri mchog ci mchis pa// dmigs yul rten gyi lha la dri 'bul na// bde chen ye shes= /oṃ gan+dhe kā ma= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// ro mchog khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// dmigs yul rten gyi lha la zas 'bul na// bde chen ye shes= oṃ ra sa kā ma= phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// dmigs yul rten gyi lha la gos 'bul na// bde chen ye shes= oṃ spar+she kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ mthar/ 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// longs spyod chad pa med pa dang*// rtsod pa med cing 'tshe med pa// rang dbang du ni spyod par shog /kha zas bstabs pa 'di yi mthus// 'khrul snang 'jigs skrag thams cad zhi// bar do rang ngo 'phrod gyur nas// dag pa'i zhing du skye bar shog /byang bu mer bsregs nas lam bstan bya// bsregs na thun bzhi'am/ mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud sogs skabs dang bstun// me sbar ni/

tshe 'das rgyud kyi ma dag pa'i// phung po khams dang skye mched rnams// sku lnga ye shes lnga yi mes// bsregs pas byang zhing dag par gyur// rtsa sngags brjod cing ming byang bsregs la thal ba gtsang sar dor ro// lam bstan ni/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne rat+na sam+bha we rat+na ki ra ṇe/ rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos shing*// srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma sam+bha we ma hā su kha wa tī gats+tshan+tu swā hā// tshe 'das de nyid bde ba can tu skyes te de'i rgyu rkyen brtags pas cho ga'i mthu yin par shes nas 'di nyid du lhags te slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la// e ma'o sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma'o sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag sbyangs nas// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod// de ltar ched du brjod cing drin lan gyi tshul du mchod pa// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod pa ci rigs bya/ slar yang bde ba can du song nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byed cing gsung gi gdams pa nod par gyur// oṃ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ me tog 'thor/ bsngo smon bya/ de nas rjes chog sogs gzhung ltar byas pas khyab pa'o// zhes jo bo lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar drug pa'i gsung ltar yan lag byang chog dang bcas pa nag 'gros su bsdebs pa'o// lhag bsam du ma'i dpal 'dzin byang 'dren thub bstan pas// bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i rnam dag dbye ba las// rgyal ba mi 'khrugs cho ga'i chos sbyin legs byas kyis// mkha' khyab ngan 'gro'i dgra las rnam rgyal dpal du shog
/ces pa tā yi si tu pas spar byang su bris pa dge// /sarba maṅga lam/
